svg.text: Meridian Resource & Traffic Management Platform · feature-level view of the entire build, mapped to sequential delivery
Generated 27 Aug 2026 · source: docs/TASKS.md · phase % = build completion (parked go-live / carry-forward tasks excluded from the denominator)
A task is a task everywhere
Phases 0 & L read as essentially complete: done-in-substance items (0.1–0.3, L1.5, L3–L4) are marked Done; L5 pilot/go-live steps are Deferred (they execute at go-live, not during Phase I).

I4 chat is done for CAMPAIGN work only; ad-hoc tasks have no chat (I15, ADR-0046 proposed — campaign-less authz). Other open build: L1.6, small L2/L6 tails, I14 onward. MVP engine (M1–M5) shipped early.
Badge = total tasks in the feature; fill bar & colour show completion. Fully editable SVG (grouped rects + text).
